commit_subject: (screen-flagged) b1.6 (PR #1300): removes hard-coded exemplar entry_is_line_a..e derived rules (proof atoms citing other chapters' HTS lines) from every generated chapter and makes them caller inputs; summary claims runtime semantics unchanged — unsure, part of the same decoupling repair.
description: The generated compositions move from the witness's five per-line exemplar flags to membership-semantic caller inputs

triage.pre_fix_wrong_because: The chapter 02 composition defined entry_is_line_a..e as equality tests against five exemplar statistical reporting numbers from other chapters, grounding chapter-02 §301 / §122 / reciprocal-exclusion gating on provisions outside this chapter's scope so those branches could never fire for any line chapter 02 actually covers.

triage.verifier_justification: I tried to refute this as a pure interface refactor and could not: the ch02 diff deletes five derived rules whose formulas were equality tests against statistical reporting numbers from chapters 72, 76, 95, 22 and 85, and those flags were the sole gates on chapter-02's reciprocal annex exclusion (`formula: entry_is_line_a`), reciprocal metals exclusion (`formula: entry_is_line_b`), §122 surcharge exclusion (`(if entry_is_line_a or entry_is_line_b: 0`), beer §232 gate (`formula: entry_is_line_d`) and the entire `china_301_component_rate` sum, so every one of those branches was constant-false for any line chapter 02 can classify. The pinned corpus settles that this was a disagreement with source, not harmless scaffolding: the §301 note list the module's own proof atoms cite enumerates chapter-02 subheadings (`0203.29.20 0203.29.40 0206.10.00 0208.10.00 0208.90.20 0208.90.25 0210.19.00`), yet the pre-fix component could only fire on a ferroalloy, aluminum, football, beer or PV line. Removing the out-of-chapter bindings so incidence comes from entry preparation is exactly the untraceable_branch remedy ("formulas grounded on the wrong provision... the fix removes or re-grounds it"), and the companion tests confirm the meaning moved (positive-coverage cases changed from `input.hts_number: 7202.11.10.00` to `input.entry_is_line_a: true`). The kind holds over wrong_entity_or_scope because the defect is a condition with no basis in chapter 02's cited text rather than a rule pointed at the wrong population.

triage.verifier_notes: Refutation attempts and residual doubt, for the reviewer: (1) The fix is partial at this commit. The consuming formulas and their proof atoms are byte-identical after the change — ch02 still carries `((if entry_is_line_a and origin_is_china: list_1_additional_ad_valorem_rate else: 0)` with atoms citing 7202.11.10.00, 9506.62.40, 7601.10.30.00, 2203.00.00 and 8541.42.00. The slots stay exemplar-shaped; only the binding is externalized to an unencoded caller. The PR body's "membership-semantic caller inputs" and the §122 regating onto `entry_is_section_122_exempt` / `entry_is_section_232_covered` land in sibling commits of PR #1300, not here, and the PR's own issue comment says c and e were only later "fully replaced". A reviewer who requires the fix commit to re-ground on in-chapter source could downgrade this to unclear. (2) The first reader's reading overstates the harm in one direction: for chapter 02, `if entry_is_line_a or entry_is_line_b: 0` being dead meant the §122 surcharge was never wrongly zeroed, which the PR itself calls the lawful outcome; likewise the aluminum, beer and PV gates being false is substantively right for meat. The real under-coverage is §301 (and arguably the annex exclusion). Making the flags free inputs at this commit actually re-opens the §122 zeroing path until the later regating commit. (3) Screen note's "summary claims runtime semantics unchanged" is a false alarm: that sentence is pre-existing boilerplate about the parenthesization serialization, and the new summary explicitly says the five identifiers are now caller inputs. (4) Alternative kind if the reviewer prefers it: wrong_entity_or_scope (a chapter-02 module deriving judgments about other chapters' lines). Corpus evidence read this session: `us/statute/hts/chapter-99/page-265` under release us-rulespec-2026-08-08-obbb-alien-snap, corpus commit e79781bddeaba4d3697c5375c7371b2a038f0f74; pages 265-270 are one ascending run of the same note list the module cites, with 22xx lines appearing only in the later run at page 273.
